generator: tools/topic-vectors.mjs via tools/release.mjs (viem encodeAbiParameters + keccak256; the grammars from the NatSpec of src/profiles/TopicProfile.sol)

grammar.word: 1..255 bytes of strict UTF-8; no '/' or '\', no ASCII control, space or A-Z; no scalar of `refused` (so no Unicode whitespace); not '.' or '..'; not starting with '~'; not '0x' and exactly 40 of 0-9a-f

pathRuleCodes.10: not exactly two refs and headers
pathRuleCodes.12: the parent is neither topic/1 nor topic-word/1
pathRuleCodes.13: the second ref is not a topic-word/1 record (the kernel refuses it first: E_REF code 2)

grammar.text: 1..255 bytes of strict UTF-8; no C0, DEL or C1 control; no scalar of `refused` classes 2, 3 and 5; '/', '\', U+0020, class 6 (no-break and typographic spaces), uppercase, joiners and variation selectors admitted

textCodes.23: a bidi control, an invisible scalar or a noncharacter (classes 2, 3, 5)

grammar.order: the byte codes (2, 3, 7; 21, 22, 23) are the first found scanning from the start; the length code comes first and the whole-word shapes (4, 5, 6) last
grammar.error: E_TOPIC_REFUSED(uint8 code) on a direct call; through the kernel E_REJECTED(leaf, typeId)
grammar.sdk: fold (lowercase, NFC, the SDK's fold rule) and refuse before building a plan; the chain never normalizes

refused.note: fixed at the first lasting deployment of topic-word/1; may change until then (the SDK fold rule is not confirmed). Sorted, disjoint, inclusive ranges

classes.6: whitespace a text admits (Unicode White_Space minus ASCII, U+0085 and U+2028-2029)

entries.what: Arabic pound and piastre marks above (Cf)
ZERO WIDTH NON-JOINER, ZERO WIDTH JOINER
U+FFF0-FFF8 and the interlinear annotation characters
OBJECT and REPLACEMENT CHARACTER, U+FFFE, U+FFFF
the rest of the default-ignorable block

ids.path: n = 1: the word page; n >= 2: Keys.record(topic/1, abi.encode(pathId(first n-1 words), wordPage(last word)))
ids.propertyKey: keccak256(abi.encode(keccak256("efs/property-key/1"), keccak256(key))); a label key is propertyKey("label:" ‖ the BCP 47 tag lowercased (ASCII A-Z only), so pt-BR is pt-br)

order: register every word page and path record before use and strictly before the first statement on it (an earlier action of the same publication counts): pages first, then the path records from two words on, then the statements
